extraction_metadata.description: Comprehensive extraction of Maximum Allowable Stress Values (S) from ASME BPVC Section II Part D (Metric Edition). Table 1A = Ferrous Materials, Table 1B = Nonferrous Materials.
extraction_metadata.page_structure_note: Each ASME table spread is 4 pages: DEF (material definitions) → PROPERTIES (P-No, strengths, applicability) → STRESS (values at 40-475°C) → STRESS_HI (values at higher temperatures). The stress values are on DEF_page + 2, NOT DEF_page - 2.
